rules.title: Every record matches its JSON Schema, and text is well-formed ICU MessageFormat
Every record lives where its id says, ids are derived from content, and nothing else lives in the data folders
Every reference (skill, standard, locale, lesson, prerequisite, misconception) points at something that exists; prerequisites never loop
A framework's text is copied only as far as its recorded terms allow
Every lesson teaches at least one skill, and every skill it teaches is aligned to at least one standard
The text a learner reads fits the youngest age the lesson says it is for
Every graded item has one answer that exists, cannot be confused with another choice, and says how it was verified
Neither the prompt nor a hint shows the answer
A prompt that is heard, not shown, names a recorded audio asset that has a licence and an attribution
Every picture and sound has a record with an allowed licence and its attribution
No email address, phone number, web address or account handle in content or provenance
No term from the safety lexicon of the lesson's language; a language without a lexicon is refused
No item appears twice, by id or by what it asks and accepts
Nothing is `reviewed` or `published` without a passing review by a person who did not make it; an `exact` alignment needs one too
A `reviewed` or `published` record was passed by a person REVIEWERS.json lists for that role, language, subject and framework
Against a base revision, nothing reviewed changes silently: it moves forward, is reopened with a higher version, or is revised by a new record
The index is the one the data generates, never a hand edit
